title: Install or recover Email
summary: Deliver a committed candidate through Cell or select matching tested Email artifacts and a verified retained release, with separate authority for any real-send verification.
use_when: Email needs ordinary Cell delivery or an explicitly authorized manual program installation or recovery.
do_not_use_when: The task only needs credential/domain selection, live mail inspection, or an unauthorized verification send.
outcome: Verified selected Email programs and matching installed documentation, or an explicit installation/recovery failure.
effects: Cell submission authorizes the installed manager delivery workflow and its outcome email. Manual installation or recovery selects Email programs and the matching provider bundle.
Program probes and registration read/send no mail. A separately authorized validation send discloses its subject/body to Resend and Gmail.
authority: The operator authorizes manual installation/recovery and selects tested matching artifacts. Email owns program selectors and integrity.
The CI manager owns ordinary committed-candidate delivery. The user or authorized caller owns any real-send authority.
success: Verify the retained manager outcome for ordinary delivery, or selected help/version and provider publication for manual installation/recovery.
A separately authorized send verifies Resend acceptance; Gmail receipt requires separate observation.
failure_and_recovery: Stop on foreign selector ownership, unverified artifacts or missing canonical owned previous release. Preserve errors and verify restored selectors after a failed post-switch check.
Recover with a trusted tested installer; keep private account setup and uncertain mail acceptance under their owning procedures.
privacy: Keep credentials and private account settings separate from artifact selection. Probes read/send no mail; an authorized real send discloses exact content to Resend/Gmail.
does_not_authorize: Remote provisioning, credential replacement, taking over foreign selectors, mail reads, or a real-send verification without separate authority.

consumers.statement: Current-user operators performing authorized Cell delivery, manual program installation, recovery or separately authorized real-send verification.

preconditions.statement: Use a validated candidate and matching trusted tested binary, Rust installer and complete bundle. Manual actions need explicit authorization; real sends need separate send authority and configured access.

inputs.statement: Ordinary delivery names a committed source candidate. Manual installation names matching tested binary/bundle paths; recovery names the canonical owned retained release.

outputs.statement: Retained manager outcome or verified selected program/version and matching provider publication. A real-send receipt, when separately authorized, reports Resend acceptance only.

data_semantics.statement: Installation evidence describes selected program artifacts. Provider publication describes their documentation. Neither grants credential, mail-read or send authority.

identity_and_units.statement: Commit IDs select Cell candidates; content hashes identify immutable Email releases. previous must resolve to its canonical owned release directory.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verify the selected program and publication after installation/recovery. Resolve gaps remain explicit; catalog validation establishes no live Resend/Gmail readiness.

access.statement: Follow the current-user Cell submission or tested installer path. Retained installer bytes require verification before execution. Keep credential bytes out of arguments and deployment JSON.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The installed manager owns ordinary delivery. Manual post-switch failure restores selectors; supported recovery verifies an owned retained release before selecting it. Account settings remain separately selected.

operational_limits.statement: Program verification uses help/version and usage registration with no mail access. Real-send checks are separate authorized operations and Gmail receipt is observed separately.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: This operation publishes existing CI, installation and verified legacy/cell-install-v2 recovery routes; it changes no executable or public send/receive behavior.

reliances.statement: Ordinary delivery relies on the installed serial CI manager contract and its retained outcome; this procedure does not perform its workflow.

steps: Select the authorized validated candidate or matching tested artifacts.
Submit ordinary delivery or perform explicitly authorized manual selection.
Register usage and verify selected help/version and provider publication.
Recover only a verified canonical owned retained release; authorize any real-send check separately.
checkpoints: Programs and matching documentation select one verified release.
No credential or mail access occurs during program probes.
Manager success, program selection, Resend acceptance and Gmail delivery remain separate evidence.
adaptation: Use Cell submission for ordinary delivery and the tested installer only for explicitly authorized manual installation/recovery.
Keep private account settings correction under email.account.operate.
stop_when: Artifact or selector ownership cannot be verified.
A required previous release or action authority is missing.
Program verification or retained manager delivery reports failure.
